title: Cozy Cottage Near Downtown
description:
Sleeps 6 comfortably: 2 queen beds & 2 twins; 1 full bath, kitchen, security system, Cable TV & Wifi. Just 5 minutes to downtown. Near interstate, Metro Center, Nissan Stadium, Broadway, Vanderbilt, TSU, Meharry, & Fisk University.

The space
The space is family friendly. A Pack and Play is available upon request for infants and toddlers.

Guest access
Check in time 2 p.m. Central Standard Time. Check out time 11:00 a.m. Guests will have access to the entire 3-bedroom house which is 816 sq. ft. with living room and eat-in kitchen. There will be parking in front of the house for guests.  Host will provide a code for entry.

Other things to note
1.  Principal renter must be at least 21 years old. 
2. Cleaning fee: $75.
3. Security Deposit: $100. 
4. $25 per day per person for extra guests over 6. 
5. Maximum number of guests is 7.
6. In Nashville the government requires hosts to collect a $2.50 per night tax and one-time $2.50 cleaning fee tax. These taxes will be calculated and disclosed to guest before bookings are confirmed. 

For example, the taxes for a two night stay is $7.50. That is $5.00 for per night tax and $2.50 for cleaning service.  The taxes are not included in the Airbnb charges guests initially receive; however, all other taxes and fees are.
